dataset.title: Comprehensive electromagnetic experimental dataset of the Wuxi polymetallic mining area in southern Anhui

freeze.grouping_rule: Keep each processed line and each raw CMD/CMS basename indivisible. Assign roles by ascending line number or acquisition date using contiguous deterministic blocks.

audit_constraints.reason: This freeze prevents outcome-guided role selection; geometry, source metadata, uncertainty support, independence, and leakage safety still require training-only audit.

workbook_geometry_protocol.stage_1: Read workbook structure, sheet names, dimensions, and at most the first 10 rows per sheet to identify headers.
workbook_geometry_protocol.stage_2: Permit full-column reads only for columns whose stage-1 labels unambiguously denote identifiers, method, line, station, coordinates, elevation, acquisition metadata, or units.
workbook_geometry_protocol.forbidden_columns: Do not read columns labelled as measured or corrected field response, apparent resistivity, amplitude frequency, polarization, magnetic field, inversion, model, prediction, residual, or uncertainty outcome.
workbook_geometry_protocol.role_effect: Coordinate-only reads may cover every role because they cannot reveal response outcomes; any response-bearing column remains restricted to training.
